Read input: autovcoder_073675.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_073675 (
    CLK50,
    SW,
    KEY,
    RESET_N,
    LEDR,
    HEX5,
    HEX4,
    HEX3,
    HEX2,
    HEX1,
    HEX0
);
  input CLK50;
  input [9:0] SW;
  input [3:0] KEY;
  input RESET_N;

  output [9:0] LEDR;
  output [6:0] HEX5;
  output [6:0] HEX4;
  output [6:0] HEX3;
  output [6:0] HEX2;
  output [6:0] HEX1;
  output [6:0] HEX0;

  wire       CLK;
  wire       CLK_SEL;
  wire       RESET;
  wire       EN_L;
  wire [7:0] IOA;
  wire [7:0] IOB;
  wire [7:0] IOC;
  wire [7:0] IOD;
  wire [7:0] IOE;
  wire [7:0] IOF;
  wire [7:0] IOG;

  assign RESET   = ~RESET_N;
  assign CLK_SEL = SW[9];
  assign EN_L    = KEY[2];

  lab4 daCore (
      .CLK  (CLK),
      .RESET(RESET),
      .IOA  (IOA),
      .IOB  (IOB),
      .IOC  (IOC),
      .EN_L (EN_L),
      .IOD  (IOD),
      .IOE  (IOE),
      .IOF  (IOF),
      .IOG  (IOG)
  );

  var_clk clockGenerator (
      .clock_50MHz(CLK50),
      .clock_sel  ({CLK_SEL, CLK_SEL, CLK_SEL}),
      .var_clock  (CLK)
  );

  dual_reg_in inputs (
      .CLK(CLK),
      .IN(SW[7:0]),
      .SEL(SW[8]),
      .WEN_L(KEY[3]),
      .OUTA(IOA),
      .OUTB(IOB)
  );

  // PUSHBUTTON INPUT LOGIC
  assign IOC[7:2]  = 6'b0;
  assign IOC[1]    = ~KEY[1];
  assign IOC[0]    = ~KEY[0];

  // LED ARRAY LOGIC
  assign LEDR[9]   = CLK;
  assign LEDR[8]   = 1'b0;
  assign LEDR[7:0] = IOD;

  // SEVEN-SEGMENT DISPLAY DRIVERS

  hex_to_seven_seg upperIOG (
      .B(IOG[7:4]),
      .SSEG_L(HEX5)
  );

  hex_to_seven_seg lowerIOG (
      .B(IOG[3:0]),
      .SSEG_L(HEX4)
  );

  hex_to_seven_seg upperIOF (
      .B(IOF[7:4]),
      .SSEG_L(HEX3)
  );

  hex_to_seven_seg lowerIOF (
      .B(IOF[3:0]),
      .SSEG_L(HEX2)
  );

  hex_to_seven_seg upperIOE (
      .B(IOE[7:4]),
      .SSEG_L(HEX1)
  );

  hex_to_seven_seg lowerIOE (
      .B(IOE[3:0]),
      .SSEG_L(HEX0)
  );

endmodule
